You can use the search bar at the top of the page to look for previous posts about moderated mediation.  For example, this thread includes a link to an informative article.  

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lavaan/NUGvCsEgoN0/f1Xv5qlIDR4J

Once you understand what you are doing, you should be able to write the syntax.  The short answer is that your path diagram doesn't represent what you can do in covariance structure analysis.  You need to think about how interaction terms work in regression.  See Figure 2 in the article linked in the thread above.  The long answer is that you can label the effects of X, W, and X*W in your syntax, then calculate indirect effects by summing those labeled parameters at different values of W -- details are provided in the article.

Terry
